definitions.explanation: Something beyond ordinary human understanding that inspires awe or wonder. Refers to the mysterious quality of nature, the divine, or the universe. Often used with {的|てき} to form the na-adjective {神秘|しんぴ}{的|てき}.

examples.japanese: {生命|せいめい}の{神秘|しんぴ}に{触|ふ}れる。
examples.english: To touch upon the mystery of life.

examples.japanese: {深海|しんかい}には{神秘|しんぴ}{的|てき}な{生|い}き{物|もの}がたくさんいる。
examples.english: There are many mysterious creatures in the deep sea.

examples.japanese: オーロラの{神秘|しんぴ}{的|てき}な{美|うつく}しさに、{言葉|ことば}を{失|うしな}った。
examples.english: I was left speechless by the mystical beauty of the aurora.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used in the form {神秘|しんぴ}{的|てき} (mystical, mysterious) as a na-adjective. Carries a positive, awe-inspiring connotation unlike {不思議|ふしぎ} (strange, puzzling) or {謎|なぞ} (riddle, enigma).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神秘|しんぴ}{的|てき}な: mystical, mysterious
- {神秘|しんぴ}に{包|つつ}まれる: to be wrapped in mystery
- {生命|せいめい}の{神秘|しんぴ}: the mystery of life
- {自然|しぜん}の{神秘|しんぴ}: the mystery of nature
- {神秘|しんぴ}{体験|たいけん}: mystical experience
